notes: Generated locally with rui 0.6.0 (pip -e checkout at commit 4f00ef5) via:
PYTHONPATH=src python -m rui plug-test src/rui_xiaoai_bridge --adapter rui_xiaoai_bridge.adapter:build --json
The 5 SKIPs are the inbound LX06 surface: open()/capture/playback need the real open-xiaoai client to dial in.
Cross-check on the released v0.6.0 tag (what CI installs): 15 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 WARN / 5 SKIP.
The WARN is device.probe_layout: the v0.6.0 release kit builds the adapter with a fake config that does not
resolve the manifest's audio_defaults, so probe() reports 1 mic / 0 ref; it is a kit/config artifact, not an
adapter failure, and the same check is PASS on main @ 4f00ef5 (report above).
